selection_policy: Use only actual newly exposed editing candidates/profiles from the single bound v6 pack. This case fixes independent observation criteria before rendering.
photo_scene: A fictional adult woman gliding through a final slow lap of a nearly empty night roller rink, turning toward her rink-edge friend with the camera as she approaches the skate-return counter.

criteria: Hard frontal highlight transitions on the sharp woman, especially cheek or satin folds.
A short cast floor shadow associated with her skates and a dimmer ambient rink.
fail_if: Only general brightness or smooth ambient lighting appears.

criteria: One sharp principal skater remains readable.
An evident short continuous trailing exposure is attached to her moving sleeve and/or wheels toward screen left.
Fixed rails or counter edges remain stationary and readable.
fail_if: Only soft focus or shallow depth of field occurs.
Trails have conflicting directions or look like unrelated duplicated anatomy.

criteria: Fine irregular brightness texture is visible at native resolution in dark wall and shaded jacket areas.
Tiny sparse colored speckles, including green or magenta, are visible in these shadow areas.
Noise is relatively reduced across the brightly exposed face while facial texture remains readable.
fail_if: Only fabric weave, skin pores or large monochrome film-grain-like marks occur.
Noise is not identifiable at native resolution.

criteria: One adult sharp body, with connected and plausible shoulders, elbows, knees and skates; intentional exposure trail is distinguishable from extra anatomy.
Visible skate wheel sets meet a common floor plane, with staggered feet and softly bent knees supporting a plausible slow coast.
Her modest head turn, outward balance arm and glide direction are mutually plausible and both skates remain inside the frame.
The generated fictional adult woman keeps the visible short dark bob, fine parted bangs, soft rounded facial contour, dark eyes and naturally pink lips from the supplied appearance guide.
reference_gate.scope: Face/hair appearance only; no identity/biometric/personality/body-shape claim.

editing_exposure.selection: Two eligible new source-bound slot candidates selected; selected visual concepts explicitly empty.
editing_exposure.focal_test_coverage: Three independent core advisory assertions and the pre-render native-pixel case; no requester-required assertion invented from authorial testing choices.

added_candidate_realization: Cyan LEDs in her existing moving wheels provide a native ambient-light source for the source-bound shutter-trace candidate. The original independent trail direction, sharp endpoint and still-architecture tests remain unchanged.
